_说明.Documentation: Full translation input: items, glossary, synopsis. Output: items[{id,translation}] and glossary_used. Keep {{STYLE_HINT}}. Synopsis is context, not text to translate.

system_prompt: Translate manga bubbles faithfully into English. Return JSON only.
user_prompt_prefix: Input items contains id and text; glossary is authoritative; synopsis is saved, continually updated plot context exclusive to full translation. Use synopsis only to understand explicit background, never to replace source text or invent dialogue. Bubble order does not establish conversation order. Preserve ambiguity; do not infer speakers, gender or relationships. Return items (id, translation) with each input ID exactly once. For meaningless text return the ID with an empty translation. Also return glossary_used containing only new proper names and their translations. Do not return or expand the synopsis.
